ruling.question: Does C-Q08-1 apply when the record holds execution reports but none in force?
ruling.answer: YES in substance: reports of sessions (not done, replaced or disputed) in the window mean the record covers it; 'unknown stays unknown' is about the intake's unstated exposure. The gate rows.some(executed) is a pre-existing fidelity gap, not the decided reading.
ruling.shapeB: A session whose reports all say completed, with only the amount disputed, is an execution of disputed amount, not no execution. Zero minutes for the bound is acceptable; reading it as no session for the pause, last executed day and trainedAfter is not, and after a readiness declaration it skips the SB-1 reason question (pre-existing for direct conflicts, identical on d92aa88).
why: pre-existing on d92aa88 for records reported not done or directly conflicted; the fix only applies the as-if oracle
bound worst case = self-report cold start envelope
narrow class: no execution in force anywhere (or after the declaration for trainedAfter)
synthetic and shadow standing, V1 authority NO
the right change is a design decision (bound vs ASK; disputed-amount counting; effect on direct conflicts) larger than 'fix only CORE-C2-F01'
